applicationInfo.name: Threat Model Export
applicationInfo.description: Loom is an enterprise-grade AI security gateway, Model Context Protocol (MCP) containment boundary, and multi-agent governance platform providing zero-trust edge authentication, deep schema and cryptographic validation, and telemetry compliance normalization.

mitigations.content: ExtAuthz Pre-execution Delimiter Neutralization & Prompt Injection Marker Scanning
Ed25519 Publisher Cryptographic Contract Signing and Boot Verification
Kernel-Level Descriptor-Relative Sandboxing (openat, O_NOFOLLOW) in SafeFS
Bidirectional Presidio PII Masking and Deterministic Secret Scrubbing
Durable Dollar Budgets ($50/day block) and Upstream Circuit Breakers
Mandatory Document-Level Security (DLS) Pre-Filtering in Vector Search
Cryptographically Hash-Chained Audit Ledger in Normalizer Service
Zero-Trust SPIFFE/SPIRE Workload Identity with Ephemeral X.509 SVIDs and mTLS

businessContext.description: Loom is an enterprise-grade AI security gateway, Model Context Protocol (MCP) containment boundary, and multi-agent governance platform providing zero-trust edge authentication, deep schema and cryptographic validation, and telemetry compliance normalization.

components.name: AgentGateway
components.description: Perimeter API gateway handling OIDC JWT claim verification, token rate limiting, dollar budgets, and initial CEL tool allowlisting.

components.name: ExtAuthzService
components.description: Control plane gRPC External Authorization server on port 9001 performing deep JSON schema validation, Ed25519 contract verification, path traversal checks, and prompt injection detection.

components.name: SafeFSServer
components.description: MCP SafeFS tool container running descriptor-relative openat filesystem operations with O_NOFOLLOW sandboxing under /workspace.

components.name: GuardrailProxy
components.description: Bidirectional DLP proxy evaluating prompts and completions with Presidio PII redaction and secret scanning.

components.name: OTelCollector
components.description: OpenTelemetry Collector Contrib with OTTL privacy transforms stripping raw prompt text and preserving GenAI attributes.

components.name: NormalizerService
components.description: Telemetry normalization service ingesting OTel trace spans, injecting SPIFFE workload identity, and outputting UnifiedFinding audit records.

components.name: StrandsSwarmRunner
components.description: Multi-agent swarm execution orchestrator running role-scoped agent tasks with ephemeral credentials and taint lineage.

components.name: ExternalLLMProvider
components.description: Upstream frontier model APIs (OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic) executing model inference.

connections.description: Agent calls model and tools via gateway with Bearer JWT.
Gateway queries and updates budget balances in SQLite.
Gateway delegates deep JSON schema, Ed25519 contract, and injection checks to ExtAuthz.
Gateway forwards validated tool calls to SafeFS.
SafeFS accesses workspace files via descriptor-relative openat syscalls.
Gateway forwards prompt text to Guardrail proxy for bidirectional PII/secret inspection.
Sanitized prompt sent to external LLM API for inference.
AgentGateway exports OTLP trace spans and metrics to collector.
OTel collector forwards privacy-scrubbed spans to Normalizer /v1/traces.
Normalizer writes hash-chained UnifiedFinding records to SQLite queue.
Agent executes pre-filtered vector search queries with tenant context.

flows.description: Prompt payload inspected for PII and secrets prior to model dispatch.
Tool contract verified cryptographically via Ed25519 signature before tool execution.
Normalized telemetry findings hash-chained and persisted into SQLite ledger.
Tenant token and dollar balances queried and updated in persistent store.
Agent executes vector similarity queries with mandatory tenant pre-filtering.

residualRiskAssessments.rationale: Mitigated by ExtAuthz delimiter stripping, injection marker scanning, and structural prompt isolation.
Mitigated by offline Ed25519 publisher signature verification at boot with fail-closed termination.
Mitigated by kernel-enforced descriptor-relative openat resolution with O_NOFOLLOW in SafeFS.
Mitigated by bidirectional Presidio NLP analysis and deterministic regex secret masking.
Mitigated by AgentGateway daily dollar budget hard block ($50/day) and upstream provider circuit breakers.
Mitigated by mandatory Document-Level Security (DLS) pre-filtering enforced before vector traversal.
Mitigated by cryptographic SHA-256 hash chaining of UnifiedFinding records in the SQLite queue.
Mitigated by mandatory TLS 1.3 mTLS with SPIFFE/SPIRE SVIDs limited to <= 10m TTL and peer ACL validation.

nonFunctionalRequirements.rationale: Edge gateway must inspect tokens and enforce ExtAuthz checks within millisecond latency budgets.
Perimeter security gateway must be highly available for upstream inference traffic.
Security boundary must fail closed on missing credentials, tripped circuits, or unverified contracts.
Protects against prompt injection, model jailbreaks, and unauthorized code execution.
Integrates with OpenID Connect, SPIFFE/SPIRE, Envoy ExtAuthz, and OpenTelemetry.
Decoupled edge gateway, ExtAuthz server, SafeFS sandbox, and telemetry normalizer.
Rejects malformed tool calls, invalid schemas, and path traversal attempts.
